matched_snippet.code_behavior: At runtime during the firmware installation process, the code validates the bundle signature using check_bundle(), then closes the file. malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The separation between signature verification and actual use of the file introduces a Time-of-Check-Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) race condition, allowing the file to be swapped after verification but before installation.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Firmware update processes are expected to atomically verify and install the exact same file, preventing any tampering between verification and installation steps.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: None; atomicity is a fundamental security requirement for update mechanisms, and legitimate processes should never allow the verified file to be replaced before installation.
